title: InMnTi2: Weyl-node census of a magnetic Heusler

decision_points.fork: Which archived calculation describes the magnetic state: `standard` has no starting magnetization and no magnetization in its output (non-magnetic PBE+SOC, time-reversal symmetric); `hubbard` is the DFT+U magnetic state
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the standard (PBE) model as the magnetic Weyl semimetal
decision_points.consequence: node energy 38.88 meV (above E_F), separation 0.155 1/A, kz offset 0, a single orbit of 24

decision_points.fork: Which Wannier bands carry DFT bands 52/53: hubbard 16/17 (exclude_bands 1-34 plus two bands below dis_win_min), standard 18/19 (exclude_bands 1-34, no disentanglement)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Offset 34 from exclude_bands for the hubbard model (bands 18/19), or the same Wannier index in both models
decision_points.consequence: 72 DFT+U 'nodes' at +0.66 to +1.44 eV, or 119 PBE nodes at -361.0 meV

decision_points.fork: Whether the DFT+U Wannier model can be trusted for node energies and momenta: it reproduces DFT to 0.4 meV on its 9x9x9 fitting grid (the scf k-points) but breaks the magnetic symmetry between grid points; the archived DFT lines through one node pair are the reliable evidence
decision_points.wrong_choice: Take energy and separation from the Wannier nodes (validated on the scf/nscf grid)
decision_points.consequence: energy -73.22 meV (family mean) or -91.89 meV (pair at the DFT line), separation 0.396 or 0.385 1/A

decision_points.fork: How the magnetic symmetry (8 operations, 4 combined with time reversal; k -> -Rk for those) organises the nodes, including the C2T stabiliser of nodes on the kx = 0 / ky = 0 planes and the Wannier scatter of positions
decision_points.wrong_choice: Cubic non-magnetic group (one orbit of 24, as the paper states), unitary operations only, planar families, or in-plane versus out-of-plane split

decision_points.fork: The kz displacement of the near-kz=0 family and its tie to chirality (chirality of bands 1-52 from Berry flux, position from the DFT z-line)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Chirality of the upper band (sign flipped), or a symmetric node in the kz = 0 plane

decision_points.fork: What the Kubo folder names 10-300 are: k-mesh sizes (berry_kmesh in kubo/InMnTi2.win, fixed 2 meV smearing), not broadenings; convergence across meshes is non-monotonic
decision_points.wrong_choice: Read '10' as the narrowest broadening, or accept a ~50^3 mesh

decision_points.fork: Whether the archived nonzero sigma_yz, sigma_zx are physical: they are forbidden for moments along z (C2z, C2x T) and come from the symmetry-broken Wannier model
decision_points.wrong_choice: Report the archived converged values of all three components

decision_points.fork: Fermi-energy reference: the standard/nscfXYZ output prints a Fermi energy (15.7968 eV) computed from its line k-points; only the scf value (15.6841 eV) is meaningful
decision_points.wrong_choice: Reference the PBE node energies to the latest printed Fermi energy
decision_points.consequence: PBE node energy -73.82 instead of 38.88 meV

decision_points.fork: True nodes versus gap minima: the PBE pairs are 0.155 1/A apart (merged on grids up to 24^3) and six minima keep a ~6.6 meV gap (avoided crossings)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Count gap minima of a coarse grid, or count every minimised point with a gap of a few meV

length_estimate.catalog_units: archived items worth 32 units (4 DFT runs x 3, 6 Kubo folders x 2, 4 WannierTools runs x 2) plus any number of Wannier evaluations (1-2 units each)
length_estimate.why: Two Wannier censuses (scan, minimisation, chirality), band-index mapping against DFT, a magnetic symmetry analysis with antiunitary operations, discovery that the DFT+U interpolation fails off its fitting grid and extraction of the node from the archived DFT lines, and a Kubo convergence and symmetry check; each wrong fork moves a graded value outside its tolerance.

runtime_dependencies: numpy and scipy (runtime image); no extra layer
notes: Adapted from the candidate design (see the construction README). The archived DFT+U Wannier model is built on a 9x9x9 grid and breaks the magnetic symmetry by up to ~0.1 eV between grid points; graded node energy, separation and kz offset therefore come from the archived DFT lines, and counts, orbits and chirality from the Wannier model. The optical onset is not graded (the archived Kubo onset is smeared by the Gamma pocket and the Wannier node scatter, so it is not uniquely recoverable); it is a rubric item. Memorised paper values: E_W = -96 meV and 0.37 1/A pass; the paper kz shift 0.0047 and "all nodes equivalent" fail.

node_energy_meV.definition: mean of the DFT 52/53 crossings on the x, y, z lines (fit window 0.03 1/A)
